name: Chatabird
author: chatabird

sections.description:
Chatabird is a plugin that allows you to easily add Chatabird’s chat functionality to your WordPress website. With a simple setup process, you can have a professional chat solution up and running in minutes.

Features

  • Easy integration with Chatabird
  • Simple configuration through WordPress admin
  • Customizable app ID and identity validation
  • Lightweight implementation

External Services

This plugin connects to an external service hosted at https://em.chatabird.com to load the Chatabird chat widget.

What is sent:
– The script loads the chat widget and initializes it using your Chatabird Site ID.

Why:
– This is necessary to embed and operate the Chatabird live chat interface on your website.

Service Provider:
– Chatabird (https://chatabird.com)

Terms of Use: https://chatabird.com/terms
Privacy Policy: hhttps://chatabird.com/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the chatabird folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings > Chatabird to configure your App ID and Identity Key
sections.faq:
Where can I find my App ID?

You can find your App ID in your Chatabird settings menu

Is the Identity Key required?

The Identity Key is optional and only needed if you’re using Chatabird’s identity validation features.
